name: Twin Mysteries

start.dialog: Twin Red: We have a riddle! / Twin White: A mystery! / Twin Red: Find the three mirrored stones! / Twin White: Hidden where sky meets earth! / Both: Solve it and receive WISDOM!
start.objective: Find three mirrored stones hidden where sky meets earth in the Uplands

progress.dialog: Twin Red: One stone found! / Twin White: Two more to go! / Twin Red: Look where clouds touch! / Twin White: Look where eagles nest!
progress.objective: Continue searching for the remaining mirrored stones

complete.dialog: Twin Red: All three! / Twin White: You see clearly! / Twin Red: Here - our mother's crystal! / Twin White: It shows the truth behind reflections! / Both: Use it wisely!

party_comments.kade: Finishing each other's sentences. Kind of creepy.
party_comments.nix7: Synchronized speech patterns suggest telepathic connection.
party_comments.renna: The stones resonate with Light Foundation energy.

hidden_outcome: If you find a fourth hidden stone, the Twins reveal they are actually one person split by a Foundation anomaly
